purpose: Review whether a prospective Pennsylvania vendor has both an established legal-entity history and an established legal-name-aligned domain history before an automated workflow continues.

decision_policy.established_vendor: Unique strong Pennsylvania registry match, entity age at/above minEntityAgeDays, registered domain aligned with the resolved legal name, and domain age at/above minDomainAgeDays.
decision_policy.human_review: Any failed, unavailable, uncertain, ambiguous, recent-entity, recent-domain, unregistered-domain, or identity-mismatch condition.

claim_boundaries: established_vendor is a maturity/history workflow signal only
entity age does not establish current good standing, ownership, authority, legitimacy, creditworthiness, or legal compliance
domain age and legal-name alignment do not prove domain ownership or control
older entity/domain history is not proof a vendor is safe or trustworthy
recent entity or domain registration is a review signal, not proof of fraud
